note: GMT-Master II 40 template measure (126710BLNR first). Pixel measurements on references/rolex-gmt-master-ii-126710blnr/rolex-126710blnr_original.png (native 1920 x 2857 RGBA upright studio render, no working copy; same camera/pose family as the other Rolex renders, own scale). pivot = hub screw (960.4, 1424.0) -> int (960, 1424). Scale: the coin-edge bezel tips are the widest part of the head: left tip envelope at the pivot row x 496.9 (alpha 24/255 at x 496, 218 at 497; silhouette radius from the ring centre 461.1..463.4 over rows 1300..1560, median 462.8), case / bezel centre x 959.7 (bracelet edges symmetric about 959.7..960) -> 40 mm = 2 x (959.7 - 496.9) = 925.6 px, 23.14 px/mm (lug width 456-458 px = 19.8 mm, crown diameter 158 px = 6.8 mm, lug to lug rows 903.5..1992.5 = 47.1 mm: consistent with the real 126710BLNR). Rings (radial edge scans, gaussian 0.7, full-circle fits with outlier rejection about the ring centre (959.6, 1424.0)): dial edge r 309.3 (black chapter), rehaut engraving ring 311..326, flange / crystal edge r 351 (bright silver ring 327..351 then a dark inner bezel wall 356..366), bezel inner edge (rise of the chamfer) r 366.4, insert outer edge (rise to the polished rim) r 436.05 (rms 0.9), rim outer edge (fall into the flutes) r 442.9, coin edge 60 flutes (FFT harmonic 60 of the azimuth profile at r 450..459; the alpha silhouette shows no flutes, the case body is behind them) spanning r 442.9..462.7 (tips). Hands (about 10:09:30): hour 305.5 deg Mercedes, minute 63.55 deg, seconds 186.4 deg, GMT 152.9 deg (blue shaft width 9.4 px = 0.4 mm along the principal axis of the blue pixels, centre line 1.7 px beside the hub screw, triangular lume head with a vertical right edge at x 1094.5 drawn over the 5 o'clock index). Crown box: fluted body x 1428..1488, cap to 1514, y 1359..1517 (axis 1438 = 0.6 mm below the pivot, radius 79 px); the guard edge is the straight line x 1472 (rows 1290..1346 and 1530..1590, crown rows 1350..1524 take it). tip_rows_px = lug top y 903.5 and lug bottom y 1992.5. The photo has no drop shadow and no logo marks (single alpha component).
